title: Izmir to Host NATO EDGE 2026 Next Week; 284 Tech Companies Signed Up
excerpt: NATO's technology gathering NATO EDGE opens in Izmir on 17 November. Ankara says 284 tech companies are coming, including 30 from Türkiye.
